text.p: Centex Construction Products Inc said Thursday it completed its previously announced purchase of Eagle-Gypsum Products' gypsum wallboard plant and the concurrent acquisition of a related cogeneration power facility, both located in Gypsum, Eagle County, Colorado.

The price of the acquisitions totaled about $52 million plus net working capital, the company said, with about $44.2 million allocated to the wallboard plant and about $7.8 million allocated to the cogeneration facility.
CXP, which is about 51 percent-owned by Centex Corp, has operations in Cement, Gypsum Wallboard and Concrete/Aggregates.

CXP's two Gypsum Wallboard plants, in the Albuquerque, New Mexico area, produce about 700 million square feet of wallboard annually. The acquisition will increase the total productive capacity of CXP's Gypsum Wallboard operations by about 60 percent to 1.1 billion square feet annually.

CXP said the acquisitions will complement CXP's existing wallboard operation and fits well with its growth objectives. The company said it will continue to pursue other growth opportunities that will enable it to reach its strategic goals.
